dz: 克劳狄乌斯被普拉多里亚卫队所封为罗马皇帝,他们暗杀了前一位皇帝,他的外甥卡利古拉.
de: Claudius is proclaimed Roman emperor by the Praetorian Guard after they assassinate the previous emperor, his nephew Caligula.

t: 经过一晚上的谈判,克劳狄乌斯被元老院接受为罗马皇帝.
te: After a night of negotiation, Claudius is accepted as Roman emperor by the Senate.
